source: made up: working parent of a teenager juggling an afternoon orthodontist run, work calls, and dinner
persona: Claire, an HR director working from home and parenting 14-year-old Lucas. Texts pragmatically with dry humor about teenager logistics, blocks her calendar around picking Lucas up early from high school at 14:15 for his 14:45 orthodontist wire adjustment, and has to pivot when he asks for soft foods after his braces get tightened.
situation: Thursday morning at 06:45. Working remotely 08:30–17:30 with a 10:00 benefits renewal meeting and a 16:00 candidate interview, plus signing Lucas out of school at 14:15 for his 14:45–15:30 orthodontist appointment.
life: 06:55 Wake up and text the app: Thursday plan! Need to make sure Lucas is awake and out the door for the school bus by 07:30, walk the dog and eat breakfast before 08:30, work 08:30–17:30 (with a break from 14:00 to 15:45 to pick Lucas up from high school, take him to his 14:45 orthodontist appointment, and bring him home before my 16:00 interview), then make dinner at 18:00.

07:00 Remind the app that during work today I need 90 minutes to review the 2027 open enrollment benefit guide PDF, 45 minutes to prep questions for the 16:00 VP of Finance interview, and 15 minutes this morning to call the high school attendance office so Lucas gets an early dismissal pass for 14:15.
07:05 Knock on Lucas's door twice, make coffee and toast, see him out to the bus at 07:30, and walk the golden retriever until 08:20.
08:25 Report Lucas on the bus, dog walked, and breakfast done. Calling the high school attendance office right now before my 08:30 work start.
08:25 Call the attendance line to request Lucas's 14:15 early dismissal pass, then start reviewing the 2027 open enrollment benefits guide PDF until 09:55.
09:58 Report attendance office called and benefits guide review done! Joining the 10:00 Benefits Broker Renewal meeting.
10:00 Attend Benefits Broker Renewal meeting until 11:15 (ran 15 minutes over discussing dental tier pricing).
11:18 Text the app: broker meeting ran until 11:15. Going to prep the interview scorecard and questions for the 16:00 VP candidate right now before lunch.
11:20 Draft the interview scorecard and behavioral questions in Ashby until 12:10.
12:12 Report interview prep done! Heating up minestrone soup for lunch and throwing a load of bath towels in the washer.
12:15 Eat lunch and start towel laundry until 13:00.
13:02 Report lunch done. Answering employee HR tickets and updating the open enrollment slide deck until 14:00.
14:00 Leave the house to pick Lucas up at the high school front office at 14:15 and drive to the 14:45 orthodontist appointment.
14:45 Orthodontist puts a heavier archwire on Lucas's braces; appointment finishes at 15:25 and Lucas says his teeth already ache too much to chew the crispy baked tacos planned for dinner.

15:30 Text the app from the car: orthodontist done, heading home for my 16:00 interview! Lucas's teeth are super sore from the new wire, so swap tonight's dinner from baked tacos to mashed potatoes and broccoli cheddar soup, and add a 25-minute grocery stop at 17:35 right after work to grab Yukon gold potatoes and soup.
15:48 Arrive home, grab a glass of water, and join the 16:00–17:00 VP of Finance candidate interview on Zoom.
17:00 Write up candidate feedback in Ashby and wrap up afternoon Slack messages until 17:35.
17:36 Report interview and feedback done! Running 5 minutes down the road to the grocery store for potatoes, cheddar, and ice cream for Lucas.
17:38 Quick grocery run, returning home at 18:05.
18:10 Make broccoli cheddar soup and garlic mashed potatoes, eat dinner with Lucas, and load the dishwasher until 19:35.
19:40 Report dinner and dishes done. Fold the clean bath towels from earlier while watching TV until 20:15, then read until bed at 22:45.
constraints: High school attendance office must be called before 09:00 to issue a 14:15 early dismissal pass.
Must leave home at 14:00 for school pick-up and return by 15:50 for the 16:00 candidate interview.
After an orthodontist wire tightening, dinner must be soft food (soup/mashed potatoes) rather than crunchy tacos.
